# VinCrux

> VinCrux is the stage name of Raosaheb Ramteke, a Nagpur-born (India) record producer and songwriter. He makes electronic, house, hip-hop, alt pop and alt R&B music that pairs melody-forward writing with club-ready sound design, and releases independently through his own imprint, VinCrux Records.

## Key facts

- Real name: Raosaheb Ramteke
- Born in: Nagpur, India
- Started producing: 2018
- First single: 2020
- Reach: tracks broadcast on SongdewTV, reaching more than 200 million households
- Label: VinCrux Records (independent)
- Styles: melodic house, tech house, pop rap, R&B, cinematic; mostly 100–130 BPM
- Tagline: Soundtracking life

## Latest release

- [Somewhere EP on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/3nRfFfG3xoatRyegrMwMLX): released 9 October 2026. Tracks: 1. Somewhere (2:01), 2. Stay, Stay, Stay (2:28)
- [Somewhere EP on YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_lV6qQ5jps2y5T6u80MdlnmX_tLdjtNLz8)

## Discography

- [Love in the house](https://open.spotify.com/album/1zlZVDKal9Z8VcwoUkoOZC): album, 16 tracks, including "Bloom", "Magnet", "Our last night" and "Give me back"
- Within: track and video
- Get Up: dance-floor track
- [Full catalog on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4XfqiAjGUVn2rAjU90cAwE)

## Press

- [Music for All (Brazil), "VinCrux une paz e adrenalina em “Stay, Stay, Stay”, single que convida a fugir da rotina"](https://musicforall.com.br/vincrux-une-paz-e-adrenalina-em-stay-stay-stay-single-que-convida-a-fugir-da-rotina/) (15 October 2026, by Traves Taylor, in Portuguese): review of "Stay, Stay, Stay", praising how it blends calm and adrenaline, with UK garage and alternative dance influences
- [TopMusic.News, "EDM Music for Party and Dance Floor"](https://topmusic.news/featured/edm-music-for-party-and-dance-floor-by-superpop-tv/) (16 May 2022): features "Get Up"
- [SpaceSour, "Best of the Moon: Best Tracks of the Month, Chapter Three"](https://spacesour.com/best-of-the-moon-best-tracks-of-the-month-chapter-three/) (31 March 2022): includes "Get Up"
- [Sleeping Bag Studios, "VinCrux – Within"](https://sleepingbagstudios.ca/vincrux-within/) (8 January 2021): review of "Within"
